description: This file defines the MessagePackCodec class and related options within the Orleans.Serialization namespace, handling serialization and deserialization with MessagePack in Orleans. It includes code for a codec class, its options, and extension methods for adding MessagePack serialization to a serializer builder.

classes.name: MessagePackCodec
classes.description: A partial class implementing multiple serialization and copying interfaces to handle MessagePack encoding and decoding within Orleans.

classes.description: Configuration options for the MessagePack codec, including support for data contract attributes, type support functions, and serializer options.
